name: NHTSA VPIC Vehicle API
tagline: Free US government VIN decode and vehicle manufacturer data from NHTSA
description: The NHTSA Product Information Catalog Vehicle Listing (vPIC) API provides free, no-auth access to official US vehicle data including VIN decoding, manufacturer details, makes, models, and plant information. Hosted at vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov, it returns JSON or XML for public use by developers, insurers, and fleets needing accurate vehicle attributes without registration.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public government API; call endpoints directly over HTTPS with no API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public government API; no paid tier. Usage limits not published as a fixed free quota.

use_cases: decode a 17-character VIN into make, model, year, and body class
look up vehicle makes and models by manufacturer
get manufacturer details and plant information for a vehicle
validate VIN check digit and decode error codes from NHTSA
retrieve vehicle type and safety-related attributes from official US data
